# Standinkey packs

Keyboard layouts and application shortcut sets for
[Standinkey](https://zenrepublic.agency), served as static files over GitHub
Pages.

**This repository holds published content only.** It is generated by
`tools/gen_packs.py` in the Standinkey source tree and should not be edited here
— an edit would be overwritten by the next deploy, and the `sha256` in
`index.json` would stop matching.

## What is here

| | |
|---|---|
| `index.json` | every pack on offer, with a size and a SHA-256 for each |
| `layouts/*.json` | 26 keyboard layouts, captured from Windows itself |
| `apps/*.json` | 12 application shortcut sets, covering 26 programs |

Ten further layouts and five programs ship inside the app and are deliberately
**not** published here: offering them would be offering somebody what they
already have.

## How the app uses it

Two plain HTTPS GETs and nothing else — no SDK, no account, no API. The app
fetches `index.json` when its packs screen is open, and one pack file when
somebody installs it. No headers of ours, no query string, no cookies, and
nothing fetched in the background.

The digest in `index.json` is **checked**, not merely recorded. A layout wrong by
one entry is a key that types the wrong character into a password field and says
nothing about it.

## Format

A pack is the document the app already parses, plus five keys of metadata:

```jsonc
{
  "pack": "layout/fr-fr",   // id, stable for the life of the pack
  "kind": "layout",         // "layout" | "shortcuts"
  "name": "French",
  "revision": 1,            // bumped when the content changes
  "min": "0.22.0",          // oldest app version that can read it
  "layouts": [ /* … */ ]
}
```

Two rules the app refuses a pack for, whether it was downloaded or opened from a
file: it may not carry the US layout `00000409`, from which every shortcut
legend on the keyboard is derived, and it may not carry the `windows` shortcut
set, which every unrecognised program falls back to.

The full format, and how packs are authored and deployed, is in `docs/packs.md`
in the source tree.
